intent_snapshot.goal: Move the agent-local config loader out of runtime/advisory_dispatch.ts into a new runtime/agent_config.ts that survives the v3 island deletion. Slice 005 established that imm_core.ts was not a pure re-export barrel: it owned the only implementation of resolveImmuneBrainLocalRoot, resolveImmuneBrainLocalPath, and readImmuneBrainConfig together with their private TOML parse and merge helpers, and deleting the barrel relocated that code into advisory_dispatch.ts, which is one of the seven modules the next deletion slice removes. The dependency direction is the substance of this slice: agent_config.ts must own the AdvisoryDispatchConfig and WorkflowModelOptions types the loader returns, and advisory_dispatch.ts must import them back, so the new module carries no dependency into the demolition set and the island deletion stays a pure deletion. Reversing that direction would compile and pass today while breaking the moment the island is deleted. This slice is behavior-preserving relocation only: it does not wire the loader into any caller and does not retire it. Whether the [subagent_activation] policy that only this loader can read should be wired up or removed from AGENTS.md and the packaged planner and brainstorm contracts is a separate decision and is deliberately out of scope here, as are the island deletion itself and any renaming of the relocated types.

acceptance.assertion: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/agent_config.ts exports resolveImmuneBrainLocalRoot, resolveImmuneBrainLocalPath, and readImmuneBrainConfig and defines the AdvisoryDispatchConfig and WorkflowModelOptions types; advisory_dispatch.ts defines none of them and imports what it still needs from agent_config.ts, so agent_config.ts imports nothing from any of the seven island modules.

Local root resolution, rejection of absolute, parent-traversal, and backslash relative paths, and the documented override precedence in which IMMUNE_BRAIN_AGENT_CONFIG overrides IMMUNE_BRAIN_CONFIG which overrides the Pi-root config.toml, all behave exactly as they did before the move.

evidence.summary: Added plugins/immune-brain/runtime/agent_config.ts with the loader, TOML parser/merge helpers, AdvisoryDispatchConfig, and WorkflowModelOptions. advisory_dispatch.ts now imports the types and defines none of the loader symbols; all seven-island dependency checks and direct importer expectations pass in tests/agent-config-rehome.test.ts and tests/imm-core-barrel-retirement.test.ts. Full bun test passes: 973 pass, 0 fail.

Moved the exact local-root/path validation and TOML config precedence implementation without behavioral edits. tests/agent-config-rehome.test.ts covers absolute, parent-traversal, and backslash rejection plus IMMUNE_BRAIN_AGENT_CONFIG > IMMUNE_BRAIN_CONFIG > Pi-root config.toml; existing config tests cover array replacement and stage metadata. Focused suite and full bun test pass: 973 pass, 0 fail.

approvals.summary: Immutable bundle provenance verified; loader ownership and unchanged path/config precedence behavior satisfy both acceptance assertions.
